metadata.title: AWS Infrastructure Knowledge Base — Master Index
metadata.description: Master index for the RAG-ready AWS Infrastructure Decision Intelligence knowledge base. Points to all knowledge base files and their entry counts. Designed for Qdrant vector database ingestion.
metadata.ingestion_notes: Each 'entries' array element in the referenced files is a self-contained RAG chunk. Embed the full entry as the document text and store category/concept/id as Qdrant payload metadata for filtering.

qdrant_ingestion_schema.description: Recommended Qdrant payload schema for each knowledge base entry

payload_fields.concept: string — concept name for semantic search boosting
payload_fields.section: string — one of: Core Terraform Concepts | AWS Infrastructure Patterns | Production Best Practices | Terraform Architecture Patterns
payload_fields.tags: string[] — topic tags for hybrid search filtering
payload_fields.aws_pillars: string[] — Well-Architected pillars this entry supports

qdrant_ingestion_schema.embedding_text_strategy: Embed the full entry JSON as a formatted string: 'Concept: {concept}. Description: {description}. Decision Rules: {decision_rules joined}. Tradeoffs: {tradeoffs joined}. Anti-Patterns: {anti_patterns joined}.'
qdrant_ingestion_schema.recommended_chunk_overlap: Each entry is a complete, self-contained chunk. No splitting required. Average token count per entry: 400-600 tokens.
